jobs.title: Project Manager - Southwest
jobs.description:
Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a leading renewable energy EPC firm, is seeking a Project Manager to lead the execution of utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repowering projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.

As a Project Manager, you will create long-term value by leading project teams that deliver safe, reliable, and profitable results. You will apply Principle Based Management to strengthen ownership, improve execution discipline, make sound economic decisions, and build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships from pre-construction through closeout.

This is a remote role that requires travel to field construction project sites at a frequency between 25% - 50% dependent on project need.

Our Team

DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes turnkey PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repower projects, including collection substations and generation transmission lines. The team partners with vendors, subcontractors, utilities, and internal capabilities to deliver disciplined project execution and strong customer outcomes nationwide.

What You Will Do

Lead project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and profitable outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, quality, compliance, and customer expectations.
Develop and execute project plans, forecasts, risk mitigation strategies, and phase-gate deliverables from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.
Apply economic thinking to evaluate cost, risk, schedule, and value tradeoffs while making timely decisions that improve project outcomes.
Build and develop high-performing teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for contribution, and aligning strengths to project and business needs.
Coordinate customers, subcontractors, vendors, utilities, consultants, and internal partners to support transparent communication and disciplined execution.
Strengthen customer and stakeholder relationships by resolving challenges, honoring commitments, and creating mutual long-term value.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience managing EPC, industrial, infrastructure, utility scale renewable energy, or large capital projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars
Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, risk mitigation, contracts, or customer commitments.
Experience leading project teams, subcontractors, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders.
Valid US driver's license.
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future.

What Will Put You Ahead

EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects.
Experience leading self-perform construction execution on large or complex projects.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
PMP, CCM, PE, or other relevant project management or construction industry certifications.
Experience partnering with Business Development, Estimating, Operations, or customers to support project pursuits, repeat business, and executable project solutions.

For this role, we anticipate paying $150K - $200K per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify. Please click here for additional information. (For Illinois E-Verify information click here , aquí , or tu ).

jobs.title: Program Manager, AMER Professional Services PMO
jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Do you excel at managing the transformation of complex customer environments, working to drive business transformation and large-scale migration efforts for enterprise clients? If so, joining our team as a Program Manager for Transformation and Migration means playing a pivotal role in delivering customer outcomes as they migrate to the Nutanix Cloud Platform. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting edge technology and collaborate with top industry professionals to deliver business changing results via innovative solutions for our clients.

What's unique about the Professional Services team at Nutanix is our commitment to delivering exceptional service and solutions to our clients. We take pride in our ability to understand and address the unique challenges our clients face with their IT infrastructure. With a diverse and talented group of professionals, we work collaboratively to provide innovative strategies and implement cutting-edge technologies. Our team's dedication and expertise have been recognized with the NorthFace Service Award for 10 consecutive years, highlighting our consistent success in exceeding client expectations. Joining our team means joining a dynamic and globally recognized organization that values excellence and continuous growth.

The Program Manager is expected to bring program management and technical knowledge of large scale Data Center (DC) modernization, IT transformation, Hybrid cloud, Intra/Inter DC Virtual Machine (VM) migration projects, infrastructure and Operations, and deep functional domain knowledge as well as solid program management skills to work collaboratively with the customer resources and the Nutanix project team to deliver results.

About The Team

You’ll be joining our Professional Services Team at Nutanix, a dynamic and collaborative environment where you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a diverse and talented group of professionals spread across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. The team culture is grounded in excellence and innovation, with every member dedicated to delivering exceptional service and tailored solutions to meet our clients' unique IT infrastructure challenges. Our track record of success is underscored by receiving the NorthFace Service Award for ten consecutive years, demonstrating our commitment to exceeding client expectations and driving continuous growth.

You will report to the Global PMO Leader, who also serves as the Sr. Manager for AMER. Our work setup is designed to provide flexibility, allowing for a remote working environment, which means you can work from the comfort of your home or any preferred location. However, we do expect the team members to come into the office occasionally, with most roles requiring no set in-office days. In terms of travel, be prepared for up to 30% travel as you engage with clients and participate in projects that may require on-site presence. This balance of remote work and travel offers a unique opportunity to connect with colleagues and clients while enjoying the flexibility of a modern work environment.

Your Role

Define program success criteria and objectives, involving relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility and desired quality
Collaborate with senior customer leaders and NTNX services leaders to define the program governance (controls) in accordance with customer requirements
Coordinate and drive sub projects and work streams inclusive of their interdependencies
Lead architects and resourcing team to schedule internal and external consulting resources to drive multiple work streams
Develop detailed integrated project plans to put services in a logical order of operations, considering dependencies, predecessors, and successors while also utilizing the LOE to determine duration; monitoring and tracking progress with project plans
Manage the program scope, schedule, changes, costs and closeout using appropriate verification techniques
Anticipate and proactively resolve challenges to program budget and timeline
Measure program performance using appropriate tools and techniques
Manage and track program issues, actions and risks accordingly
Communicating progress both internally and externally
Managing the relationship with the client and all internal and external stakeholders
Utilize client facing status meetings to manage customer expectations, escalate issues and risks, and drive program activities forward
Develop client program status reports and distribute on regular intervals
Internally forecast program revenue accurately on a quarterly basis and regularly maintain configurable within system of record
Create and maintain comprehensive program documentation
Collaborate with project managers worldwide to improve PM efficiency
Foster relationships with clients enabling future account sales
Expertise in multiple project dashboard creation and presentation to all levels of stakeholders and management including executive and C level leadership
Manage Customer satisfaction by ensuring world class project delivery
Managing stakeholders' communication and develop appropriate communication plans, report and escalate to management as needed
Provide Nutanix PS Consulting large program and project opportunity pre-sales support including, but not limited to, determining the appropriate PMO roles and level of effort (LOE) required to deliver the scope successfully, identifying and addressing key risks, and managing and communicating effective throughout the pre-sales support process

What You Will Bring

You should have a minimum of 8 years of experience in a Program Management role in a professional services organization
Deep experience with managing complex programs comprised of a variety of hardware, software, infrastructure, and cloud platforms and platform integrations
Exceptional organizational skills including ability to plan, attention to detail, facilitation, time management, leadership and multitasking skills
Ability to work with clients and stakeholders to identify business objectives and align program deliverables to them
Ability to align the deliverables (outputs) to the program's outcome
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Proven ability to problem solve and be dynamic in complex situations
Self-starter with intense drive for improvement and delivering results
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project planning tools
Proficient with Agile project management
Experience using change management processes for dynamic professional services projects
External customer-facing management experience (including partners)
Internal customer relationship management experience (i.e. sales, pre-sales, advisory services)
Experience managing multiple programs, projects, and clients in parallel is required
Working knowledge with tools like NetSuite and Salesforce a plus
Ability to adopt new processes and tools
PMP required, PgMP preferred

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 172,000 and USD $ 215,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Moits is an established contractor with more than 40 years of experience delivering major projects across civil and infrastructure, bulk earthworks, demolition and remediation. With a strong reputation for delivering complex projects safely and efficiently, Moits continues to grow its project delivery team.

About the Role
MOITS is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to join the team and take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects across Sydney and Wollongong
.
This is a hands-on role suited to a Project Manager who is confident managing projects from planning and mobilisation through to completion, while working closely with site teams, subcontractors, clients and internal stakeholders.
The role will be based 2 days per week in Sydney and 3 days per week in Wollongong
, providing the opportunity to work across a range of projects and environments.

Key Responsibilities
Manage projects from initial planning through to completion and handover
Take ownership of project programmes, budgets, costs and commercial outcomes
Lead and coordinate site teams, subcontractors and suppliers
Manage project schedules and ensure key milestones are achieved
Monitor project performance, productivity, quality and safety
Manage client and stakeholder relationships throughout the project lifecycle
Review scopes, drawings, contracts and project documentation
Identify and manage project risks, variations and potential delays
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual, safety, environmental and quality requirements
Work closely with Site Managers, Engineers, Estimators and senior management
Provide regular project reporting and updates to management
Drive continuous improvement across project delivery

About You
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager with a strong background in construction, civil, demolition, excavation, remediation or infrastructure.
You will ideally have:
Proven experience as a Project Manager within the construction or civil industry
Experience managing projects from commencement through to completion
Strong understanding of construction methodologies and project delivery
Demonstrated experience managing budgets, programmes and subcontractors
Strong commercial and contract management skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to lead site teams and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Strong understanding of WHS, environmental and quality requirements
Relevant tertiary qualifications in Construction Management, Civil Engineering or a related discipline are desirable
Full Australian working rights - We are not accepting applications from overseas applicants.

What's On Offer?
Competitive salary package based on experience
Immediate start available
Permanent full-time opportunity
2 days Sydney / 3 days Wollongong
Strong career progression and long-term opportunity
Work alongside an experienced project delivery team

Apply Now
If you're an experienced Project Manager looking for your next opportunity with an established contractor and are comfortable working across Sydney and Wollongong, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV for immediate consideration.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

If you enjoy leading significant projects, influencing stakeholders and driving meaningful organisational change, this role offers the chance to make a real impact.

As a Project Manager within the Digital Transformation and Projects team, you’ll be responsible for leading a diverse portfolio of projects that drive innovation, continuous improvement and enhanced service delivery across Driver and Vehicle Services (DVS). Working closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders, you will identify, shape and deliver strategic business improvement initiatives that strengthen systems, streamline processes and improve customer outcomes. Combining project leadership, stakeholder engagement and business transformation expertise, you will play a key role in influencing change, driving innovation and supporting DVS to respond to current and future service delivery needs.

For further information about the role, we encourage you to review the attached Job Description Form (JDF) and contact Marco Schwald, Manager Digital Transformation and Projects on 08 6551 6470
or via email
at Marco.Schwald@transport.wa.gov.au
.

There is currently one (1) permanent and one (1) fixed term position available,
with the possibility of extension and or permanency.

Suitable applicants will be placed in a pool from which appointments will be made for this or similar future vacancies (fixed term or permanent) that arise within the next 12 months from date of first appointment across the DTMI.

About you

Proven experience leading projects from planning through to delivery, successfully managing competing priorities, resources and stakeholders to achieve outcomes on time and within budget.
Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to develop trusted partnerships and work collaboratively across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
Strong communication skills, with the confidence to prepare high-quality written documentation and convey complex ideas clearly to a range of audiences.
A strategic and analytical mindset, enabling you to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions.
Well-developed negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities and achieve positive outcomes in a project environment

As part of our team, you will enjoy

A competitive salary, and 12%
employer contributed superannuation and salary sacrifice options.
Generous leave entitlements including 4 weeks’ annual leave, 3 public service holidays yearly and long service leave every 7 years.
Access to flexible working arrangements including working from home or alternate work location for enhanced work life balance.
A fabulous employee assistance program with a range of services and support channels
Not just a job, but an opportunity to develop your career across other areas of transport.
Work for an innovative Government agency with limitless long-term career prospects.

In addition to rewarding work, we invite you to be Part of Something Real
. Learn more about our commitment to you, here.

How to Apply

Apply online
by clicking the ‘ Apply for Job
’ button and provide the following documents in Word or PDF format
:
A detailed CV that clearly outlines the skills and experiences you have gained in relation to the job description; and
A one (1) page summary outlining the key responsibilities and achievements you have had during your career in the context of the JDF and Selection Criteria.
Please, nominate two (2) referees who can provide feedback on your capacity to meet the Work-Related Requirements. At least one of the referees should be your most recent, immediate supervisor.

Applications for this opportunity close at 3pm
on 14 September 2026.
Please ensure your application is submitted on time, as late applications will not be accepted
.

About Techindo Systems Techindo Systems is a technology-driven company building innovative digital solutions across AI, web, cloud, enterprise software, and emerging technologies
.
We work with businesses to turn ideas into practical, scalable technology products. As we grow, we are looking for a Project Manager
who can bring clarity, ownership, and momentum to our projects.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, technology, people, and execution
.

What You’ll DoOwn Project Delivery Take end-to-end ownership of assigned technology projects from planning to launch.
Define project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and priorities.
Create and maintain project plans, sprint plans, and delivery roadmaps.
Identify dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks before they impact delivery.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to expected quality standards.

Work Closely With Technology Teams Coordinate with developers, designers, QA, AI/ML engineers, cloud teams, and other stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into clear, actionable tasks for the technology team.
Understand technical concepts well enough to challenge assumptions and make informed decisions.
Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, and priorities are clearly communicated.
Track development progress and remove blockers quickly.

Work With Clients & Stakeholders Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
Understand client requirements and convert them into structured project plans.
Conduct requirement discussions, project reviews, demos, and status meetings.
Set realistic expectations around scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Communicate project progress, risks, changes, and dependencies clearly.

Drive Product Thinking Understand the problem behind the requirement, not just the feature being requested.
Help define MVPs and prioritize features based on business impact.
Work with stakeholders to continuously improve the product.
Use customer feedback, data, and project learnings to influence priorities.
Balance business requirements with technical feasibility and delivery constraints.

Bring Process & Structure Establish effective Agile/Scrum practices across projects.
Run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and other ceremonies where required.
Maintain project documentation, requirements, decisions, and action items.
Track project KPIs, timelines, resource utilization, and delivery health.
Continuously improve internal project management processes.

What We’re Looking For 2–5 years of experience in Project Management, Product Management, Delivery Management, or a similar role
.
Experience working on software, SaaS, AI, web, mobile, cloud, or enterprise technology projects
.
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to understand technical discussions and work effectively with engineering teams.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.
Strong ownership mindset with the ability to take a project from “What needs to be built?” to “It’s live and working.”

Good to Have Experience working with startups or technology service companies.
Technical background or familiarity with software development.
Experience with AI/ML or cloud-based products.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, Slack, or similar platforms.
Experience working directly with clients.
Basic understanding of APIs, databases, cloud platforms, software architecture, and product development.
PMP, Scrum Master, Product Management, or Agile certification is a plus, but practical experience matters more than certifications
.

The Person We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who simply maintains project trackers.
We’re looking for someone who owns outcomes
.
You should be comfortable asking:
What are we building?

Why are we building it?

What is the simplest way to deliver it?

What could go wrong?

What does the client actually need?

And what needs to happen next?

You should enjoy working in an environment where priorities can change, teams are small, and everyone is expected to contribute beyond their formal job description.

Why Join Techindo Systems? Work on real-world projects across AI, cloud, web, and enterprise technology
.
Work closely with founders, clients, engineers, and technology leaders.
High ownership and autonomy.
Opportunity to work across different industries and technology domains.
Learn how technology products are actually built, launched, and scaled.
Be part of a growing startup where your contribution directly impacts the business.

If you love turning ideas into execution and enjoy making technology projects actually happen, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Myskillsversity is a skilling and employability platform operating across India in partnership with CSR foundations, corporate organizations, colleges, universities, and training partners. The organization designs and delivers structured Skill Development, Employability, and College to Corporate programs that prepare learners for real-world corporate environments. Through training, career readiness, and placement support initiatives, Myskillsversity focuses on practical skills, industry exposure, and professional development. With a presence in 18+ states, 600+ educational institutions, 200+ corporate and CSR partners, and multiple skills training collaborators, it runs large-scale skilling and career development projects, including job readiness, placement assistance, internships, and corporate orientation sessions.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Project Manager role based in Lucknow. The Project Manager will oversee end-to-end planning and execution of skilling and employability projects, ensuring alignment with CSR partners, corporate clients, and educational institutions. Responsibilities include defining project scope, timelines, and deliverables; coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders; and monitoring progress to meet training and placement targets. The role involves managing logistics for training programs, tracking participant outcomes, preparing reports and documentation, and ensuring compliance with project guidelines. The Project Manager will also identify risks, implement corrective actions, and contribute to continuous improvement of program quality and efficiency.
Qualifications

Project Management skills, including planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
Expeditor and Expediting skills to track deliverables, follow up with stakeholders, and ensure timely completion of project activities.
Inspection skills to review training quality, adherence to project standards, and compliance with partner expectations.
Logistics Management skills to coordinate venues, schedules, materials, and resources for on-site training and events.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills for working with CSR partners, colleges, corporate clients, and internal teams.
Ability to analyze data, track outcomes, and prepare clear project status reports and presentations.
Experience in education, skilling, CSR projects, or employability programs is an advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Management, Engineering, Social Sciences, or a related field; relevant certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are a plus.

estamos buscando talento! ¿Tienes experiencia como PM
? Entonces esto es para ti!

Somos una compañía global de servicios tecnológicos y consultoría,
perteneciente al Grupo NTT. Acompañamos a organizaciones de distintos sectores en sus procesos de transformación digital y combinamos conocimiento de negocio, tecnología e innovación para diseñar e implementar soluciones en áreas como estrategia digital, cloud, datos e inteligencia artificial, ciberseguridad, aplicaciones y operaciones tecnológicas.

Trabajamos con una cultura colaborativa, diversa y orientada al desarrollo profesiona
l, impulsando proyectos con impacto real y ofreciendo a nuestros equipos la oportunidad de crecer en entornos internacionales, multidisciplinares y en constante evolución.

Trabamos en diferentes sectores, y en este caso, buscamos un perfil con experiencia de mínimo 5 años de PM
para un cliente estrella del sector industria en Barcelona.

Como PM serás el responsable de asegurar que los desarrollos necesarios para las iniciativas de mejora y adaptaciones en el programa de fidelización se realicen con la priorización y timings adecuados. Serás quién confeccione y ejecute el roadmap que guíe estas iniciativas.

--> ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Gestión del Roadmap: Asegurar que los desarrollos necesarios para las iniciativas de mejora y adaptaciones en el programa de fidelización se realicen con la priorización y timings adecuados. Serás estricto/a en la confección y ejecución de un roadmap.

About Peepul

Peepul is an education-focused non-profit working with governments to strengthen India’s public education system at scale. We partner with national, state, and local governments to improve teaching, leadership, and system effectiveness in government schools.

Currently, Peepul works with governments in Delhi and Madhya Pradesh, impacting over 6.6 million students
, 273,000 teachers
, 2,400 school leaders
, and 90,000+ schools
. Our work has received national and international recognition, including the Commonwealth Education Award for Innovation, and is supported by leading Indian CSR partners and global foundations committed to improving educational outcomes for all children.

Driven by our values of impact, excellence, and leadership, our 200+ member team is committed to delivering lasting, system-level change in education.

Learn more: http://peepulindia.org

Programme Overview

Peepul has been partnering with the School Education Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh, for multiple years now. Working closely with the state bureaucratic leadership, Peepul has played a meaningful role in strengthening the education system of the state. The partnership has been a successful one – with national and international recognition of the work.
The PM SHRI (Prime Minister Schools for Rising India) programme is a flagship initiative of the Government of India to create model government schools that embody the spirit of the National Education Policy 2020—focusing on joyful learning, holistic development, and excellence in teaching and leadership.
In Madhya Pradesh, Peepul partners with the Department of School Education (DPI) to strengthen the implementation of the PM SHRI programme across 799 schools, building capacities of school leaders and teachers, improving school processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making at every level.

About the role

The Project Manager – Implementation
will lead Peepul’s field-based implementation efforts under the PM SHRI Programme across multiple districts in Madhya Pradesh. This is a critical leadership role that involves building strong relationships with district and block officials, guiding the implementation team (Senior Project Associates and Project Associates), and ensuring that high-quality academic and leadership interventions are effectively delivered in schools.
The role combines academic vision, operational excellence, and people leadership
. The Program Manager will play a pivotal role in ensuring that Peepul’s interventions reach schools with quality and consistency, generating insights for scale-up across the state.

Key Responsibilities (including but not limited to):
To lead project design, piloting, and implementation of interventions:

Lead implementation across assigned divisions and districts, coordinating with government officials, Peepul teams, and school networks.
Support the design, piloting, and roll-out of academic and leadership interventions such as Professional Learning Communities, Academic Samwaad, capacity-building workshops, and mentoring mechanisms
.
Ensure coherence between school-level processes and programme objectives related to teacher support, school culture, and student learning.
Translate state-level strategies into actionable district implementation plans with clear milestones.
Monitor progress, identify gaps, and provide timely course correction to ensure impact.

To manage best-in-class project implementation and monitoring:

Lead and mentor a team of Senior Project Associates and Project Associates
, ensuring high-quality field engagement and accountability.
Create effective work planning, progress tracking, and reporting systems for district teams.
Conduct school visits
regularly to provide on-site mentoring, observe classroom practices, and facilitate reflection with teachers and leaders.
Review data from school visits, CRO journals, and dashboards to identify trends and inform planning.
Collaborate with the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL)
team to design and review tools and frameworks for field tracking and evidence generation.
Document case studies, best practices, and field learnings for dissemination and continuous improvement.

To be a strong team collaborator and engage with key stakeholders:

Build and sustain strong operational relationships with District Education Officers (DEOs), DPCs, ADPCs, and BEOs to ensure alignment and ownership.
Collaborate with Content, PMU, and MEL workstreams to ensure coherence between design, delivery, and monitoring.
Represent Peepul and the PM SHRI Programme in government review meetings and external forums as required.
Foster a positive and collaborative culture of trust, learning, and accountability within the implementation team.
Build capacity within government and school leadership teams to institutionalise improvements beyond the project period.

Qualifications and Role Requirements:

At Peepul, we seek talented professionals passionate about driving educational transformation and making a positive impact. We are looking for individuals who possess the following qualifications and meet the role requirements:
Educational Background:
A relevant educational background in Education, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field.
Work Experience:
We value both professional and personal experience. Candidates with 4-6 years of experience in project management and implementation, preferably in education or development projects. Preference will be given to candidates who also have direct classroom teaching experience, ideally within the government school system for atleast 2-3 years.
Other Skills
: Strong ability to collaborate and build partnerships with senior internal and external stakeholders, including senior political figures, with excellent communication skills for diverse audiences.
Language Proficiency:
English and Hindi
Willingness to travel frequently for school visits and district engagements.

How to Apply

Apply via Peepul's careers portal using "Apply" button.

You will be required to submit:
CV (1–2 pages) outlining relevant experience and qualifications.
Cover Letter explaining your motivation to work with Peepul and alignment with the role.

For queries related to the hiring process, reach out to recruitment@peepulindia.org

About GATI

Global Access to Talent from India (GATI) is a mission-driven organization working to position India as the world's most trusted source of global talent. GATI partners with governments, industry, international employers, training institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders to build sustainable global workforce pathways, strengthen international labour mobility, and create high-quality overseas employment opportunities for Indian talent. Through strategic partnerships, policy engagement, and program implementation, GATI works to strengthen India's global workforce mobility ecosystem.

GATI is seeking an experienced Program Manager – Private Sector Engagement (Maharashtra)
to lead industry partnerships and employer engagement across Maharashtra. The Program Manager will be responsible for building and managing relationships with companies, industry associations, employers, chambers of commerce, sector bodies, and ecosystem partners to expand participation in GATI's workforce mobility initiatives. The role will focus on catalyzing private sector participation, identifying strategic partnerships, supporting program implementation, and creating sustainable employer pipelines for international workforce mobility.

This is a highly external-facing role requiring exceptional relationship management, business development, and program execution skills. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, comfortable engaging CXOs and senior leadership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where stakeholder management and execution go hand in hand.

Secure opportunities for GATI at industry events, conferences, roundtables, consultations, and networking forums.

Operations & Execution

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About BackOps

BackOps AI transforms supply-chain operations with agentic AI that automates complex workflows, freeing teams to focus on what matters most. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, we foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and measurable impact.

The Role

Engineering is at the size where the hardest problems stop being technical and start being cross-cutting. Work arrives from everywhere. Dependencies between teams get discovered late. Decisions that touch three teams wait on one person's calendar.

You would be our first Technical Program Manager, and you would own that layer. Not by adding process, but by building the smallest set of mechanisms that make the org self-coordinating, and then getting out of the way.
This role reports to the VP of Engineering with direct exposure to the CTO and the Head of Product. You will not be assembling status reports for a hierarchy. You will be deciding which programs exist and making them land.

Your Impact

Own the operating system this organization runs on: the planning cadence, how work arrives, and how it gets prioritized. Programs are the output. The system is the job.
Set the program agenda with the VP of Engineering. Decide which programs exist and which do not.
Own our top strategic programs end to end, from framing the problem through to the thing being live and working.
Build the dependency and risk picture across engineering, product, and customer delivery, and surface problems early enough that they are still cheap to fix.
Fix how work arrives. Reducing unplanned work is one of the highest-leverage things anyone can do here.
Own the operational programs that cross every team: incident and escalation design, cloud cost, and how we adopt AI tooling internally.
Define the metrics that show whether a program is working, and give leadership a trustworthy read on delivery risk without anyone having to chase it.
Grow other program managers as the function scales.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in technical program management, engineering, or a blend, including time at a startup where the process did not exist yet and you built it.
You have owned an operating system, not just programs. Planning, intake, and prioritization as a system that keeps working after you stop pushing on it.
Technical credibility with senior engineers and architects. You can hold architecture and delivery risk in the same conversation, read a design doc, ask the question that changes the design, and push back on an estimate with reasons. You do not need to write production code. You do need engineers to want you in the room.
A track record of landing an organization's most important programs across teams that do not report to you.
Experience growing other program managers, and shaping how an engineering organization works rather than only working inside it.
Clear, compressed written communication. You can put a complicated delivery risk in front of an executive in a paragraph and have them make the right call.
Comfort with genuine ambiguity. Several of the programs above do not exist yet and are yours to define.

Nice to Have

AI/ML or agentic systems experience, especially the reliability and evaluation problems that come with non-deterministic software.
You have built a planning or intake system from scratch and seen it survive a year.
Enterprise or regulated-customer delivery experience.
Incident and escalation program design.

What Success Looks Like

Every cross-team initiative has an owner, a definition of done, and a status you can trust.
Intake has a front door, and unplanned work is measured weekly rather than estimated once a year.
The org plans and re-plans without it being an event.
Escalation paths are designed, written down, and used in a real incident.
Systemic problems get fixed once rather than escalated repeatedly.
Leadership makes decisions on current information without anyone assembling it by hand.

Why BackOps

A function to define rather than inherit, with the mandate and the executive backing to do it.
Real scope: you will shape how a fast-growing engineering organization operates.
Small team with real autonomy and direct access to founders and customers.
Backed by exceptional investors and advisors.

Rewards

Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
401(k) plan, disability insurance, and life insurance.
Flexible time off.
Daily meals in the office, and regular team events and offsites.

Puraroma is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Operations Analyst to join our growing team. Website Management:
Manage and regularly update our company website, ensuring all information is current and accurate.
Order Fulfillment:
Oversee the entire order fulfillment process, including scheduling, packing, shipping, and tracking all customer orders to ensure timely delivery.
Inventory Management:
Monitor and maintain optimal inventory levels at Amazon, Blinkit, Instamart and Shiprocket warehouses to prevent stockouts and ensure product availability. 
Product Listings:
Efficiently list and manage products across various online platforms such as Flipkart, PharmEasy, NetMeds, Nykaa, and others.

Work with the marketing team to ensure product listings are optimized for search and conversion (e.g., updating keywords, ensuring high-quality images, and A+ content is utilized).

End-to-end execution of sponsored listings, display banners, and product booster ads, ensuring continuous optimization of bids and keywords to maintain a healthy Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
on e-commerce and quick commerce platforms.
Data Analysis & Reporting:
Weekly tracking of key metrics—including CTR, CPC, and Conversion Rates
—to provide actionable insights that align advertising spend with inventory levels and sales targets.
Reporting:
Generate regular reports on key operational metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
Stakeholder Coordination:
Act as a central point of contact for external stakeholders, including Chartered Accountants (CAs), suppliers, and vendors. Ensure timely delivery of materials to Puraroma and accurate reports to our accountants.
Customer Support Oversight:
Monitor and manage the resolution of customer queries, complaints, and returns/exchanges across all channels (email, social, website), ensuring high satisfaction and timely resolution.
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs):
Document and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
for all recurring operational tasks (e.g., new product listing, inventory transfer, order fulfillment) to improve training and scalability.
Office & Administrative Support:
Provide hands-on support for local logistics, office administration, and procurement of essential supplies.

Graduate from a reputed university (preferably B.Tech)
1-2 years of experience
Has working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Analytical Skills :
Strong analytical abilities with a proven track record of using data to identify trends, solve problems, and make informed decisions
Preferred knowledge of Shopify, Shiprocket, Amazon seller central platforms

Send your applications via email on varun@puraroma.in. Applications via LinkedIn Easy Apply will not be considered.

jobs.title: Outreach Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description
Larrakia Nation Aboriginal Corporation is the peak representative body for the Larrakia peoples, dedicated to caring for Larrakia people, culture, and country. The organization plays an active role in decisions affecting Larrakia communities and land, ensuring that local voices guide services and policy. Larrakia Nation delivers a diverse range of community-based services across the Darwin region, including aged and disability care, family and cultural support, tenancy assistance, and outreach programs. The corporation also operates initiatives such as patrol services, Healthy Engagement and Assistance in the Long Grass, Return to Country, Larrakia Hosts, and Land and Sea Rangers, making it a vital provider of holistic support in the area.
Role Description
The Outreach Program Manager is responsible for overseeing the planning, delivery, and evaluation of outreach services that support Larrakia people and broader community members in Darwin, NT. This on-site role includes coordinating outreach teams, developing program plans, managing schedules, and ensuring services such as patrol, engagement in the long grass, and family support are delivered effectively and safely. The manager will work closely with community members, partner organizations, and government agencies to strengthen relationships, identify needs, and improve access to services. Day-to-day tasks include supervising staff, monitoring program budgets and reporting, maintaining accurate records, and contributing to continuous improvement of outreach models. The role also involves supporting culturally safe practices, promoting Larrakia perspectives in service design, and assisting with strategic initiatives within Larrakia Nation.
Qualifications

Experience in community outreach, program coordination, or social services, including managing multidisciplinary teams and service delivery in complex environments.
Skills in stakeholder engagement and partnership building, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Aboriginal communities, government agencies, and local service providers.
Strong communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports, facilitate meetings, and engage with diverse community members respectfully.
Competence in planning, monitoring, and evaluation, including basic budgeting, data collection, and use of information systems to track outcomes and inform improvements.
Understanding of Aboriginal cultural safety, trauma-informed practice, and the social determinants of health, with a commitment to upholding Larrakia cultural values and protocols.
Relevant tertiary qualification in community services, social work, health, human services, management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience in a similar role.
Proven ability to work on-site in Darwin, NT, with flexibility to attend community locations, conduct outreach, and respond to changing community needs.
Current driver’s license and ability to meet employment-related compliance requirements (e.g., working with children and police clearances) as required.

Apply via: https://larrakia.com/jobs/

Please upload your resume and cover letter addressing the selection criteria. To be eligible for consideration you must answer the questionnaire and attach current copies of your Driver's licence, Working with Children check, National Police check (within three months). Direct applications made to LNAC staff will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Gamification Program Manager
jobs.description:
Own the bounty mechanics:

Design and iterate the prize pool structure: how rewards are sized, distributed, and tiered across participation levels
Build non-linear, probability-weighted reward systems — not flat guaranteed payouts.
Separate and manage multiple reward pools (pay-per-view vs. pay-per-action) based on what behaviors Eklipse actually wants to drive.
Define participation thresholds, qualification criteria, and eligibility rules per bounty cycle.

Own the unit economics:

Model the incremental cost vs. incremental LTV for each bounty format before it launches.
Size prize pools based on what the business can actually afford per user cohort — working directly from LTV, CAC, and retention data
Track whether each program is generating incremental subs, incremental publishing behavior, or incremental retention — and adjust accordingly
Flag programs that look good on the surface but destroy margin

Expand the gamification model across the app:

Map how Eklipse currently uses streaks, milestones, leaderboards, and rewards — identify what's working and what's missing
Design and test gamification mechanics beyond bounty: progression systems, creator levels, engagement rewards
Build the analytical framework to measure whether each gamification surface is actually changing behavior — publishing frequency, session depth, retention curves
Bring a coherent gamification strategy to product and leadership: what we build next, why, and what we expect it to move

Run the monthly program:

Execute each bounty cycle: briefing, launch, creator communication, winner selection, payout
Track participation week over week — adoption rate, drop-off point, view thresholds reached
Monitor re-engagement: are June participants coming back in July? Why not?
Coordinate with product on in-app bounty features, notifications, and gamification surfaces

Experiment and improve:

Design A/B tests on prize structures, entry mechanics, and reward timing
Test what works: does a higher-probability small prize outperform a low-probability large prize for our user base?
Bring back learnings that inform both product and marketing direction

What we're looking for:

2–3 years in growth, loyalty programs, rewards design, or program management
Comfortable with numbers: probability, expected value, unit economics, cohort analysis — you don't need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to build and defend a model
Experience owning or managing an incentive program end-to-end — loyalty, referral, gamification, or creator monetization
Strong executional ownership — you run the program, you don't just advise on it
Professional English, written and spoken

Nice to have:

Background in gaming, creator economy, or consumer subscription businesses
Familiarity with how streaming creators think about income and motivation
Experience with game economy design or virtual reward systems
Experience with Stripe, payment rails, or payout infrastructure

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of New York

When you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system.

At the Bank, we work full-time onsite with our teams. We believe being physically together allows us to draw on our collective strengths, while recognizing that the ability to work flexibly from time to time remains important to achieving our mission.

Our Unique Work:

The Research Analyst (RA) Program is a two-year program. At the direction of economists and senior research analysts or research associates, the Research Analyst will help prepare analyses, reports, and other materials for policy and research projects.

How You’ll Make an Impact as a Research Analyst:

Develop the ability to assist economists and senior staff in their Bank policy work. You will: download and assemble data; prepare charts and tables; create and maintain spreadsheets; use statistical, econometric and other software packages to perform analyses and model estimation and simulations; and assistance in preparing memos and presentations.
Develop the ability to assist economists and senior staff in their long-term research. You will: perform literature reviews and archival research; download and assemble data; prepare charts and tables; create and maintain spreadsheets; use statistical, econometric and other software packages to perform analyses and model estimation and simulations; and help with writing and proofreading articles.

Hledáme juniorního datového analytika, který chce nastartovat nebo dále rozvíjet svou kariéru v oblasti datové a business analytiky. Klíčové odpovědnosti

Pomáhat monitorovat a zlepšovat kvalitu dat kontrolou jejich správnosti, úplnosti a konzistence.
Analyzovat data za účelem identifikace trendů, nesrovnalostí a příležitostí ke zlepšení.
Shromažďovat, čistit, validovat a připravovat data z podnikových systémů, jako jsou ERP, CRM, tabulkové procesory a reportovací nástroje.

Bakalářský titul nebo probíhající studium v oblasti datové analytiky, informačních technologií, informatiky, ekonomie, podnikové administrativy či příbuzného oboru, případně odpovídající praktická zkušenost.

Základní porozumění databázím a datovým konceptům, jako jsou tabulky, pole, dotazy a vztahy mezi daty.
Zájem učit se SQL, Power BI a další nástroje pro analýzu a reporting dat.
Analytické myšlení, smysl pro detail a ochota zkoumat datové problémy.
Schopnost jasně komunikovat s kolegy z IT i businessu.
Znalost českého a anglického jazyka.

Výhodou bude

Základní znalost SQL nebo praktická zkušenost s jednoduchými dotazy.
Zkušenost s reportovacími nebo vizualizačními nástroji, jako jsou Power BI, Tableau či podobné nástroje.
Zkušenost s ERP, CRM nebo jinými podnikovými systémy.
Základní znalost Pythonu nebo jiného skriptovacího jazyka pro přípravu dat.
Zájem o podnikové procesy, kvalitu dat a kontinuální zlepšování.

Příležitost nastartovat kariéru v IT a pracovat v úspěšné skupině s inovativními produkty a globální působností.

jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of New York

When you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system.

At the Bank, we work full-time onsite with our teams. We believe being physically together allows us to draw on our collective strengths, while recognizing that the ability to work flexibly from time to time remains important to achieving our mission.

Our Unique Work:

Information Security New York (ISNY) is responsible for developing, executing, and maintaining a superior information security program that promotes resiliency by identifying and mitigating cyber risks and threats through risk-based consultation, advice, and direction for controls, designs, and investments for the entire Bank.

Within Information Security, the Cyber Security Assurance Department (CSA) is responsible for assessing risks associated with 3rd party vendors systems, software, IoT devices, ICS, technology processes, or outsourcing arrangements handling, processing, or storing Federal Reserve data. The team works directly with the business, providing guidance and managing risks. The department is also responsible for the integration of security practices into DevSecOps methodology, performing application security testing and working directly on security tooling integration as part of the CI/CD pipeline. The engagement and guidance to the product development teams are implemented through CSA analysts being embedded in the development squads to provide security advice during development and by managing the Security Champion Program in the Bank ensuring each product team has developers trained in security matters.

How You’ll Make an Impact as a Cyber Security Assurance Analyst

You will work in a dynamic team environment and play an important role in helping the Federal Reserve carry out its responsibilities. The Cyber Security Risk Analyst will be responsible for risk assessments, Cloud mitigations, security application testing, thread modeling security design review and overall information systems risk management. The role is an individual contributor who will work closely with technology squads to flawlessly deliver technological projects to the business customers. The candidate will be required to perform risk assessments which include application security testing focusing on Cloud migration workloads with specific focus on the mission critical systems supporting Markets operations. The position resides in the Information Security Function and reports to Cyber Security Assurance Manager.

Role’s objectives are:

Perform Cloud application security risk assessments.
Execute assessments timely and accurately.
Manage relationship with the business unit assigned.

Experience developing sensor systems, sensor-cleaning systems, fluid-delivery systems, or electromechanical assemblies

jobs.description:
Company Description:

Rafiki Coalition for Health and Wellness is a San Francisco-based nonprofit dedicated to eliminating health inequities and improving the lives of Black, African American, and marginalized communities in the Bay Area. For over 35 years, we have provided a safe, welcoming space where health, healing, and hope come together. We offer a holistic range of services, including free and low-cost health screenings, HIV prevention and care, mental health counseling, housing and economic support, fitness classes, and nutrition programs. Guided by a belief that wellness is more than the absence of illness, we embrace a whole-person approach that honors the cultural, social, and emotional needs of our community.

At Rafiki, we are more than a service provider. We are a trusted partner, advocate, and resource. Our work is rooted in compassion, cultural humility, and a commitment to social justice. Every day, our team stands with our community to dismantle barriers, amplify voices, and create pathways to health and opportunity.

If you're looking to join a mission-driven organization where your work directly empowers individuals and strengthens communities, Rafiki Coalition is the place to make a meaningful impact

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Facilities & Business Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of Rafiki's physical facilities, office operations, building systems, vendor relationships, security systems, space management, and workplace services. This position focuses primarily on facilities and operational infrastructure rather than executive-level organizational operations, program management, or strategic business leadership.

The Facilities & Business Operations Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing organizational operations, driving workflow improvements, managing facilities and IT coordination, and ensuring the organization's sites function efficiently and consistently. This role supervises the Facilities Coordinator and works closely with IT, Programs, Finance, and Leadership to ensure organizational readiness for programming, space rentals, community events, and partnerships. The Facilities & Business Operations Manager is a decision-maker, systems builder, and cross-departmental leader responsible for solving problems, improving processes, and ensuring operational efficiency and consistency across all Rafiki locations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Leadership & Systems Management

Design, manage, and continually improve workflows for Facilities, IT, and Operations requests.
Establish and maintain SOPs, policies, operational checklists, and approval workflows in consultation with the Operations Director.
Monitor organizational bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve efficiency.
Ensure departments follow operational processes and maintain accountability.

2. Facilities, IT, & Vendor Oversight

Serve as the primary contact for property managers, contractors, maintenance vendors, and service providers.
Oversee site readiness across all Rafiki locations, including maintenance planning, safety compliance, and equipment tracking.
Coordinate multi-site maintenance priorities and monitor progress on repairs and upgrades.
Anticipate operational risks and proactively resolve issues.

3. Space Rental Program Management

Lead the space rental process: inquiry review, agreements, floor plans, and staffing.
Coordinate across Facilities, IT, Finance, and Programs for all rental events.
Oversee rental revenue tracking, invoicing workflows, and outstanding balance follow-up.
Maintain quality assurance to ensure renters receive a consistent, professional experience.

4. Event Operations & High-Level Partnership Support

Lead operations planning for major community events, partnerships, and multi-site programs.
Build operational timelines, checklists, staffing plans, and cross-department communication structures.
Direct the onsite operations team during events and coordinate with Facilities, IT, Programs, and Finance.

5. Team Supervision & Development

Directly supervise and support the Operations Coordinator and Facilities Coordinator.
Set priorities, delegate tasks, and ensure execution across operational functions.
Assign tasks, set priorities, and ensure high-quality execution.
Conduct regular check-ins, provide feedback, coaching, and support professional development support.
Ensure coordinated coverage across sites and operational needs.

6. Strategic Operations & Organizational Planning

Support leadership in long-term planning, including capital improvements, space planning, and system upgrades.
Provide recommendations to leadership on operational risks, opportunities, and resource needs.
Prepare operational reporting, tracking metrics, and documenting improvements.

ROLE CHARACTERISTICS

Leads operational decision-making.
Creates systems; does not just execute them.
Supervises staff and manages workload across sites.
Oversees external vendors, contractors, and property managers.
Manages budgets, contracts, and operational priorities.
Acts as a strategic partner to leadership during planning.
Strong relationship manager

Requirements:

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

3-5 years of operations, facilities, or project management experience, ideally in a nonprofit or multi-site environment.
Experience supervising staff or leading cross-functional projects.
Strong systems-thinking, problem-solving, and workflow-design abilities.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple sites, competing deadlines, and operational priorities.
Experience with operational tools, SOP development, shared inboxes, and project tracking systems.

new_jobs.description:
Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a leading renewable energy EPC firm, is seeking a Project Manager to lead the execution of utility-scale Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repowering projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.

As a Project Manager, you will create long-term value by leading project teams that deliver safe, reliable, and profitable results. You will apply Principle Based Management to strengthen ownership, improve execution discipline, make sound economic decisions, and build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships from pre-construction through closeout.

This is a remote role that requires travel to field construction project sites at a frequency between 25% - 50% dependent on project need.

Our Team

DEPCOM's Project Delivery Organization executes turnkey PV, Battery Energy Storage, and Repower projects, including collection substations and generation transmission lines. The team partners with vendors, subcontractors, utilities, and internal capabilities to deliver disciplined project execution and strong customer outcomes nationwide.

What You Will Do

Lead project teams to deliver safe, reliable, and profitable outcomes across scope, schedule, cost, quality, compliance, and customer expectations.
Develop and execute project plans, forecasts, risk mitigation strategies, and phase-gate deliverables from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.
Apply economic thinking to evaluate cost, risk, schedule, and value tradeoffs while making timely decisions that improve project outcomes.
Build and develop high-performing teams by setting clear expectations, coaching for contribution, and aligning strengths to project and business needs.
Coordinate customers, subcontractors, vendors, utilities, consultants, and internal partners to support transparent communication and disciplined execution.
Strengthen customer and stakeholder relationships by resolving challenges, honoring commitments, and creating mutual long-term value.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience managing EPC, industrial, infrastructure, utility scale renewable energy, or large capital projects valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars
Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, risk mitigation, contracts, or customer commitments.
Experience leading project teams, subcontractors, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders.
Valid US driver's license.
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future.

What Will Put You Ahead

EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects.
Experience leading self-perform construction execution on large or complex projects.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
PMP, CCM, PE, or other relevant project management or construction industry certifications.
Experience partnering with Business Development, Estimating, Operations, or customers to support project pursuits, repeat business, and executable project solutions.

For this role, we anticipate paying $150K - $200K per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. new_jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.

The Opportunity

Do you excel at managing the transformation of complex customer environments, working to drive business transformation and large-scale migration efforts for enterprise clients? If so, joining our team as a Program Manager for Transformation and Migration means playing a pivotal role in delivering customer outcomes as they migrate to the Nutanix Cloud Platform. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting edge technology and collaborate with top industry professionals to deliver business changing results via innovative solutions for our clients.

What's unique about the Professional Services team at Nutanix is our commitment to delivering exceptional service and solutions to our clients. We take pride in our ability to understand and address the unique challenges our clients face with their IT infrastructure. With a diverse and talented group of professionals, we work collaboratively to provide innovative strategies and implement cutting-edge technologies. Our team's dedication and expertise have been recognized with the NorthFace Service Award for 10 consecutive years, highlighting our consistent success in exceeding client expectations. Joining our team means joining a dynamic and globally recognized organization that values excellence and continuous growth.

The Program Manager is expected to bring program management and technical knowledge of large scale Data Center (DC) modernization, IT transformation, Hybrid cloud, Intra/Inter DC Virtual Machine (VM) migration projects, infrastructure and Operations, and deep functional domain knowledge as well as solid program management skills to work collaboratively with the customer resources and the Nutanix project team to deliver results.

About The Team

You’ll be joining our Professional Services Team at Nutanix, a dynamic and collaborative environment where you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a diverse and talented group of professionals spread across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. The team culture is grounded in excellence and innovation, with every member dedicated to delivering exceptional service and tailored solutions to meet our clients' unique IT infrastructure challenges. Our track record of success is underscored by receiving the NorthFace Service Award for ten consecutive years, demonstrating our commitment to exceeding client expectations and driving continuous growth.

You will report to the Global PMO Leader, who also serves as the Sr. Manager for AMER. Our work setup is designed to provide flexibility, allowing for a remote working environment, which means you can work from the comfort of your home or any preferred location. However, we do expect the team members to come into the office occasionally, with most roles requiring no set in-office days. In terms of travel, be prepared for up to 30% travel as you engage with clients and participate in projects that may require on-site presence. This balance of remote work and travel offers a unique opportunity to connect with colleagues and clients while enjoying the flexibility of a modern work environment.

Your Role

Define program success criteria and objectives, involving relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility and desired quality
Collaborate with senior customer leaders and NTNX services leaders to define the program governance (controls) in accordance with customer requirements
Coordinate and drive sub projects and work streams inclusive of their interdependencies
Lead architects and resourcing team to schedule internal and external consulting resources to drive multiple work streams
Develop detailed integrated project plans to put services in a logical order of operations, considering dependencies, predecessors, and successors while also utilizing the LOE to determine duration; monitoring and tracking progress with project plans
Manage the program scope, schedule, changes, costs and closeout using appropriate verification techniques
Anticipate and proactively resolve challenges to program budget and timeline
Measure program performance using appropriate tools and techniques
Manage and track program issues, actions and risks accordingly
Communicating progress both internally and externally
Managing the relationship with the client and all internal and external stakeholders
Utilize client facing status meetings to manage customer expectations, escalate issues and risks, and drive program activities forward
Develop client program status reports and distribute on regular intervals
Internally forecast program revenue accurately on a quarterly basis and regularly maintain configurable within system of record
Create and maintain comprehensive program documentation
Collaborate with project managers worldwide to improve PM efficiency
Foster relationships with clients enabling future account sales
Expertise in multiple project dashboard creation and presentation to all levels of stakeholders and management including executive and C level leadership
Manage Customer satisfaction by ensuring world class project delivery
Managing stakeholders' communication and develop appropriate communication plans, report and escalate to management as needed
Provide Nutanix PS Consulting large program and project opportunity pre-sales support including, but not limited to, determining the appropriate PMO roles and level of effort (LOE) required to deliver the scope successfully, identifying and addressing key risks, and managing and communicating effective throughout the pre-sales support process

What You Will Bring

You should have a minimum of 8 years of experience in a Program Management role in a professional services organization
Deep experience with managing complex programs comprised of a variety of hardware, software, infrastructure, and cloud platforms and platform integrations
Exceptional organizational skills including ability to plan, attention to detail, facilitation, time management, leadership and multitasking skills
Ability to work with clients and stakeholders to identify business objectives and align program deliverables to them
Ability to align the deliverables (outputs) to the program's outcome
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Proven ability to problem solve and be dynamic in complex situations
Self-starter with intense drive for improvement and delivering results
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Project planning tools
Proficient with Agile project management
Experience using change management processes for dynamic professional services projects
External customer-facing management experience (including partners)
Internal customer relationship management experience (i.e. sales, pre-sales, advisory services)
Experience managing multiple programs, projects, and clients in parallel is required
Working knowledge with tools like NetSuite and Salesforce a plus
Ability to adopt new processes and tools
PMP required, PgMP preferred

Work Arrangement

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 172,000 and USD $ 215,000 per year.

However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
